name: CASBOT
summary:
CASBOT, also known as Zhongke Huiling, develops general-purpose humanoid robots and embodied-intelligence products for practical applications. Founded in 2023, its portfolio includes the CASBOT 01 and CASBOT 02 full-size bipedal robots, the CASBOT W1 wheeled platform and the Handle-L1 dexterous hand.

The company works across robot hardware, manipulation and application development, with an emphasis on moving systems beyond stage demonstrations into usable operating scenarios. Its public milestones include industrial embodied-intelligence research and partnerships aimed at scaling robot manufacturing. The combination of bipedal and wheeled platforms allows different approaches to mobility and interaction according to the needs of a deployment.
